title: entity-link
description:
One association between an account and a pseudonymous shared identifier, valid over a time range.

The time range is the point. Two accounts that used the same device two years apart are not connected; two that used it the same week may be. A link with no bounds collapses that distinction and inflates every graph it appears in.

confidence is absent for a deterministic method and present for an inferred one. Not 1.0 for the deterministic case: a certainty and a probability in the same column invite a reader to compare them.

match_method.description: How the association was established. EXACT is an observation; NARRATIVE_EXTRACTION is a guess. Which one it is decides whether the link needs a person to confirm it.

confidence.description: A fraction in [0, 1], not a percentage. 88 meaning 88% is the commonest error in this field, and it is refused rather than divided by a hundred, because guessing would be wrong for a source that really does mean a confidence above one.

valid_to.description: Open-ended when absent. Must not precede valid_from: a link that stopped being true before it started would silently match nothing in every window query.

metadata_json.description: Free-form synthetic context. Sanitised on ingestion: keys that look like secrets, tokens, raw identifiers, ground-truth labels, scenario ids or ring ids are dropped rather than stored.
